Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer on a paid plan. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you can return to the perfect layout without rebuilding it from scratch each time you open a project.

This feature is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, meaning every subscriber gets full access as soon as they log in. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize layouts for different projects, clients, or workflows without worrying about running out of space.

Saved Views can also be shared with your team, so a layout you build once helps everyone stay aligned on priorities, deadlines, and progress. Whether you're tracking sprints, managing a backlog, or reporting to stakeholders, sharing a view means less time explaining setup and more time getting work done.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
